main_text.p: fultorum enim hoc fuisse officium constat. Itaque Cicero libro de Oratore I.cùm, In testamentorum formulis versari, dixisset: subiecit statim, Hoc est, In medio iure civili.

Sic induxit.) Non lege lata, ut quibusdam placuisse video: sed cōcipienda formula, & in usum consuetudinemq; inducenda. ut si quis de acceptilatione Aquiliana sentiens sic diceret, Gallus sic posse omnes per acceptilationem dissolui obligationes induxit: Quicquid te mihi, &c. Sic Vlpianus in L.2.[?] D. de uulg. & pupill. subst. scribit, Moribus introductū esse, ut quis liberis impuberibus testamentum faciat: cum iurisconsultorum auctoritatem ac formulam sine dubio significet.

Instituì postumos.) Vel instituì, uel exheredari. Itaq; quod in formula legitur, HEREDES SVNTO: sic accipiendum est, HEREDES SVNTO, uel EXHEREDES SVNTO. Nam ut ait Vlp. L.3. D. de iniust. rupt. Postumi per uirilem sexū descendentes, ad similitudinem filiorum nominatim ex-

page.notes: Running head read as "IN L. GALLVS." Margins and page are clear. Doubtful readings: "L.2." (printed as a letter resembling z), "subst." (printed as "fubft."), and "Vel instituì" (the accent is uncertain). "Instituipostumos.)" is the printed run-in heading, read as "Instituì postumos.)" with the space supplied. The page ends mid-word at "ex-", which continues on the next page. Long s rendered as plain s throughout; "ff" printed for "ss" in "fuiffe", "placuiffe", "dixiffet" was transcribed as "fuisse", "placuisse", "dixisset".
